_comment: Site-wide FAQ. Pages can render all of it, or filter by topic in their own frontmatter.

items.question: What do you bake?
items.answer: Sourdough loaves baked daily, buttery pastries, and celebration cakes made to order.

items.question: Why is your sourdough slow-fermented?
items.answer: Time is what gives bread its flavour, its crust and its character, so we let our dough rise slowly and by hand, in small batches.

items.question: Do you have a café?
items.answer: Yes. Come in for a loaf and stay for a coffee. Our pastries are best eaten warm alongside a good cup of coffee.

items.question: Can I order a celebration cake?
items.answer: Yes. Our cakes are made to order for birthdays, weddings or just because. Get in touch, tell us what you are marking and we will talk it through with you.

items.question: How can I get in touch?
items.answer: Call us on 01712345678, email test@gmail.co, or use the contact page on this site.
